subject: Increase TID count to accomodate valkey-search reader/writer pools (#2417)
reason: The change only bumps TIDS_MAX_SIZE from 50 to 150 in src/debug.c, the buffer the crash-report signal handler uses in writeStacktraces()/get_ready_to_signal_threads_tids() to enumerate thread TIDs when dumping stack traces. It changes behavior only when the process has more than 50 threads, which requires the valkey-search module's reader/writer pools; module loading is refused in experiments and a stock valkey-server has far fewer than 50 threads, so both builds behave identically on anything the fuzzer can run. The path is reachable only during a crash dump, has no effect on replies, replica
